chunks: Then We sent Our apostles one after the other. Every time an apostle came to a people they denied him. So We made one follow the other (to its doom), and turned them into bygone tales. Cursed be the people who do not believe!
ai.seo_question: What is the consequence when a people deny their prophet according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the cyclical nature of prophetic history where denial leads to divine retribution, serving as a precursor to the ultimate salvation of the faithful. The phrase 'made them tales' (ahadith) signifies their transition from living communities to historical lessons, emphasizing the continuity of divine guidance through successive messengers. This pattern underscores the Shia belief in the inevitability of truth prevailing after the period of denial and decline.
